title: Comment reply product video: pear-shape fit question

brief.comment:
Will this skirt emphasize my hips?
The model photos do not show the fit clearly.
brief.merchantIntent: Answer the fit concern with visible front, side, and fabric evidence. Avoid universal body-shape claims and end with a waist-based size-chart instruction.
brief.audience: Pear-shaped shoppers comparing fit and deciding whether to order
brief.cta: The fabric holds its shape without feeling stiff. Check the size chart by waist before ordering.

segments.label: HIGH-INTENT COMMENT
segments.subtitle:
Pear-shaped and worried this skirt
will emphasize your hips? Let’s
check the actual fit.
segments.purpose: Acknowledge the fit concern and promise visible evidence.
